text:
You stand in a quiet village square.
The wind carries the smell of bread from a nearby bakery.

You have looked around {lookCounter} times.

An elderly villager pauses near the stone well and nods at you.

"Fresh loaves just came out of the oven at the bakery, traveler.
Stay safe if you head past the eastern woods—goblins have been prowling near the old watchtower."

The villager lowers their voice and glances toward the treeline.

"That tower has stood empty since the old border skirmishes. Folk say the cellar door is rusted shut, though nobody dares stay after sundown to check."
Warmth radiates from a brick hearth inside the cozy timber-framed bakery. Rows of golden sourdough loaves cool on wooden racks behind the counter, and the baker waves a flour-dusted hand in greeting.

"If you're venturing beyond the eastern woods, keep your wits sharp," the baker warns while wiping down the counter. "A hearty meal makes all the difference when you're nursing bruises from the road."
Shadows stir along the overgrown path as two goblins leap out from behind the trees!

Dappled sunlight filters through the tall pines of the eastern woods.
The forest path is quiet now, winding deeper toward a crumbling stone watchtower on a mossy ridge.

choices.label: Follow the ridge path to the old watchtower

text: Ivy creeps up the cracked masonry of an abandoned stone watchtower. A weathered wooden sign hangs crookedly beside a heavy, rusted cellar hatch half-buried in dead leaves.

choices.label: Head back into the eastern woods

text: Thick iron hinges groan slightly as you tug at the ring handle. A heavy, corroded keyhole sits dead-center in the oak planks—clearly locked tight from the inside.

choices.label: Step back to the watchtower courtyard

text: From the wind-swept battlement at the top of the tower, you can see the smoke of the village bakery curling above the treetops to the west and dark, jagged hills stretching across the eastern horizon.
